# Hello, I'm Pablo G. Baretto.

A 20-year software engineer transforming complex business needs into value through technology.

Today, I leverage my engineering background to focus on two specific, practical areas:
:::
:::

::: {.grid .focus-columns}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .focus-column}
## 1. Enterprise-Grade AI applied to "Boring" Business M&A

I serve as a technology consultant to Private Equity teams and Search Funds, helping them assess, plan and deploy AI in traditional business acquisitions:

- Identifying the operational bottlenecks where automation will drive SDE/EBITDA wins.
- Hunting for the hidden signals, like undocumented legacy systems or siloed data that could ruin automation budgets.
- Planning and managing the execution of tech and AI implementation roadmaps, ensuring the new systems are actually adopted by frontline workers.

[Get a Clear AI Roadmap for Your Target Business](#){data-tally-open="eqKl2J" data-tally-emoji-text="👋" data-tally-emoji-animation="wave"}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .focus-column .focus-column-right}
## 2. Private, Air-Gapped AI

For organizations that need the operational power of Large Language Models (LLMs) but have strict data privacy needs, I built Holobrain.

It is a scalable, completely private AI stack. I help companies deploy open-weights models and automated workflows entirely within their own infrastructure, ensuring that proprietary company data never leaks to public APIs.

[Learn more about secure AI deployments at Holobrain.ai](https://holobrain.ai){target="_blank"}
:::
:::
